notes: C08/C16 post-experience price-value appraisals never set a pre-purchase cost coefficient.
General cost comparison remains a scenario heuristic, not an observed personal purchasing rule.
New-experience transfer is uncertain from zero to the bounded upper level. Activities within the same visit/document bundle do not create repeated independent trials.
Direct menu match replaces the broad food transfer level with 1, rather than adding the same source twice. Food quality and meal adequacy are operator assumptions.

Information acquisition competes as a plan. It can reduce regret only for explicitly observable menu facts, after time and reservation checks; it does not reveal taste satisfaction or personal novelty preferences.
Reservation intent, attempts, reservation results, and actual use are separate states.
No score, uncertainty endpoint, or regret is a probability, willingness-to-pay estimate, or learned customer utility.
